Aesthetic Quality

  • CURIE: gmeow:AestheticQuality
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/AestheticQuality
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/affect
  • Box roles: TBox role (What is this?)

A qualitative aesthetic reading — an OPEN vocabulary seeded with elegance, sublimity, kitsch. No AestheticQuality hierarchy exists or ever will (Principle 9): aesthetic traditions disagree about the inventory, and that disagreement is data.

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:AestheticQuality as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
